openings.claim: Pattern-specific envelope quantities and post-insertion ticks may reduce memory-related omissions; exterior pattern marks may reduce assignment exchanges. Shared tagged trays are not established as necessary.
openings.discriminator: Matched-mixture local staging succeeding while marked shared-tray kits fail favors spatial interference. Correctly ticked incomplete envelopes defeat insertion verification.
openings.probe: Within 18 minutes including preparation and audit, the same two volunteers alternate three four-kit batches: incumbent trays, marked/ticked envelopes with trays, and loose local staging without quantity cues. Match recipes; tally crossings, phase times and omissions; audit against samples. Stop if staging exceeds table space.
openings.uncertainty: O4 mixture, picking versus filling errors, marking legibility and staging footprint are unknown. Rare sample use and shared-item omissions suggest quantity-memory dependence without establishing causation or 60-kit throughput.

openings.claim: Existing samples might enable tactile identification of sealed-kit pattern and one missing shared item, reducing checking burden; capability is unestablished.
openings.discriminator: Gross bulk recognition can distinguish patterns while missing single-item omissions. Repeated matched completeness confusion defeats capability despite pattern success.
openings.probe: Within one two-volunteer, 90-minute session, prepare twelve envelopes using actual pattern mixture: six complete, six matched single-item omissions. One volunteer conceals ground truth; the blinded other compares feel with samples. Require 11/12 correct pattern-and-completeness judgments and five/six omissions; repeat shuffled with new codes. Restore recipes before distribution; handle sequentially.
openings.uncertainty: Pressure, packing, envelope transmission, reusable supplies, preparation/restoration time and table fit remain unverified. Discrimination does not establish operational throughput.

lineage.reason: Preserves quantity cues, assignment visibility and spatial rival.
Preserves distinct tactile enabling capability and defeat criteria.

decision: No improvement established: all evidence is synthetic. Require 60 kits, at most one distribution correction, specified quantities/dimensions, exactly two volunteers within 90 minutes, existing 180-by-75-centimetre table and existing supplies without purchases. Track checking time; unopened-stock shortage and opened-packet footprint remain unresolved.
